title: The Golden Circle
coreMove: Use the Golden Circle as an order you can inspect: move WHY before HOW, let WHAT show the claim, and keep each hard detail in its own case.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a promise that cannot yet be proved
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apple Inc. becomes evidence, not decoration

exampleSpecs.stakes: one vivid story doing too much
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the Apple Inc. thread earns its own proof
belief goes before the visible list

exampleSpecs.stakes: true facts used in the wrong place
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: hard specifics stay inside their source
